description:
• About our brand: The forEVER Jewelry was created by a mom who understands the significance that jewelry can hold, and wanted to develop an entirely new concept for the jewelry industry. She also created it alongside a unique compensation plan that serves as a means to help ambitious women prosper through their efforts.

• Product description: The innovative forEVER Lock is the only jewelry that closes permanently with patent-pending technology that ensures a secure hold that lasts forEVER! No appointments, no welding, no second-guessing quality. It's not just jewelry, it's forEVER.

• Why forEVER? 
-The worlds first designer permanent jewelry
-100% safe
-Unique experience and ability to gift to others
-Each piece of jewelry includes: elegant packaging, a Certificate of Authenticity to guarantee quality of craftsmanship, a registered serial number unique to every piece that adds a layer of security and increases product value over time as all collections are limited runs and retire once they are sold out

• Payment terms: Payout can be requested anytime balance is over $25, or anytime as store credit.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to The forEVER Jewelry! Thanks for joining our Ambassador program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Ambassador agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Ambassador or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Ambassador Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Ambassador Program Registration.

2. Ambassador Links and Coupon

Ambassador link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an Ambassador link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Ambassador might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the Ambassador link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Ambassador may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Ambassador to receive a commission, please update account information in Ambassador Dashboard. Payment schedule will be notified on Ambassador Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Ambassador Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

The forEVER Jewelry is not a multi-level-marketing platform. We do not allow or offer any compensation for recruitment of other Ambassadors. 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Ambassador registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the Ambassador's link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the Ambassador (There’s no need for the customer to click on the Ambassador link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an Ambassador wishes to be removed from the Ambassador program, they can do so by contacting: everjewelrystudio@gmail.com.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Ambassador Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to everjewelrystudio@gmail.com for support.
